comments.body:
7-item Album related to Transmutation Alchemy recipes unlocked by the (future) "Wisdom of beauty, regalia of tradition"(g.t.) Legacy Theme. Like the Calculator, Aroma and Star Device legacies, specific discoveries will unlock each item's recipe.

Items:

Adventurer's Notes --> Dampier's Diary (2:00/upper right discovery)
Guide's Gloves --> Sailors' Formal Gloves (4:00/lower right discovery)
Throwing Torches --> Torch (8:00/lower left discovery)
Ruler --> Emperor (6:00/bottom discovery)
Plain Wood Bow --> Hamaya of Diving Protection (10:00/upper left discovery)
Gold Ring --> Ring of Royalty (12:00/top discovery)
Shamshir --> Jeweled Shamshir (0:00/center discovery)

MA Reward: Seven-Branched Sword
NPC: Nzinga Mbemba(Lisbon)

Source: wittyship.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-1347.html
